steps.text:
Agrith-Na-Na uses melee when in range and uses Fire Blast when not in melee range.
Ranged attack is effective against him.

Ice gloves must be used if using a weapon. Be sure to have a backpack space for your weapon, which will automatically be unequipped when engaging Flambeed. If you do not have an backpack space when Flambeed spawns, your ice gloves might be sent to your bank to make room for your weapon in the backpack.
Using water spells or ranged attack is effective against him.

It is recommended to bring stat restore potions.
It is also recommended to fight her in melee range with a fire spell as her melee attacks do little damage.

Iban Blast and ranged attack works well on him.
At least one restore potion is recommended as he has a chance of draining stats.

• Damage can be done to her in this order: (necromancy attack does not work)
    • Wind spells (white)
    • Water spells (blue)
    • Melee attack (orange)
    • Earth spells (brown)
    • Fire spells (red)
    • Ranged attack (green)
    • After green, she repeats the cycle.

steps.title: Culinaromancer
steps.text: Kill the Culinaromancer with any combat style.
The Culinaromancer has little to no defence but can hit over 200.
